description: This file implements a Redis-based grain directory for Orleans, providing methods for lookup, registration, and unregistration of grain addresses, as well as lifecycle management and Redis connection handling.

classes.name: RedisGrainDirectory
classes.description: Implements a Redis-backed grain directory for Orleans, handling registration, lookup, and unregistration of grain addresses with lifecycle and Redis connection management.

methods.name: Lookup
methods.description: Looks up the address of a grain by its ID.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a grain address with optional previous address check.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes to silo lifecycle events for initialization and uninitialization.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the Redis connection and database.

methods.name: Uninitialize
methods.description: Closes Redis connection and disposes resources.

methods.name: GetKey
methods.description: Generates Redis key for a grain ID.
